# BYZ scope. The chain is over; the modifiers stay as they are.
oe_s37_gal_finish = {
    set_variable = oe_s37_gal_done
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_st } remove_variable = oe_s37_gal_st } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_w } remove_variable = oe_s37_gal_w } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_open } remove_variable = oe_s37_gal_open } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_path } remove_variable = oe_s37_gal_path } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_cd } remove_variable = oe_s37_gal_cd } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_cwcd } remove_variable = oe_s37_gal_cwcd }

# BYZ scope. Galata's privileges end without an event: the author's reform 驱逐外夷 was completed, or Genoa is gone.
oe_s37_gal_lift = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_s37_galata } remove_country_modifier = oe_s37_galata }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_s37_gal_curbed } remove_country_modifier = oe_s37_gal_curbed }
    oe_s37_gal_finish = yes
}
# BYZ scope, once, on the first pulse with the Galata modifier.

# BYZ scope. One BYZ ship is lost (if there is one); counted in var oe_s37_gal_lost for the event text.
oe_s37_gal_sink = {
    if = {
        limit = { any_country_sub_unit = { is_ship = yes } }
        random_country_sub_unit = { limit = { is_ship = yes } destroy_subunit = yes }
        change_variable = { name = oe_s37_gal_lost add = 1 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The fleet is lost in the Golden Horn (event 3, fleet path, rolled before the event).
oe_s37_gal_lose_3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_s37_gal_lost value = 0 } while = { count = 6 oe_s37_gal_sink = yes }

# BYZ scope, monthly while the chain runs: count the month, fire at most one event, or drop the stage.
oe_s37_gal_step = {
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_counts = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_s37_gal_w add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_due_1 = yes } oe_s37_gal_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_due_2 = yes } oe_s37_gal_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_due_3_1 = yes } oe_s37_gal_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_due_3_2 = yes } oe_s37_gal_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_due_4 = yes } oe_s37_gal_fire_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_due_5 = yes } oe_s37_gal_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_gal_ch_1 oe_s37_gal_fire_1 = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_gal_ch_2 oe_s37_gal_fire_2 = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_open_3_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_gal_ch_3_1 oe_s37_gal_fire_3 = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_open_3_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_gal_ch_3_2 oe_s37_gal_fire_3 = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_gal_ch_4 oe_s37_gal_fire_4 = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_s37_gal_ch_5 oe_s37_gal_fire_5 = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_s37_gal_lapse = yes } oe_s37_gal_finish = yes }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly (on_action oe_s37_gal_pulse).
oe_s37_gal_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_ir_expel_done NOT = { exists = c:GEN } } }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    has_country_modifier = oe_s37_galata
                    has_country_modifier = oe_s37_gal_curbed
                    has_variable = oe_s37_gal_st
                }
            }
            oe_s37_gal_lift = yes
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_started } has_country_modifier = oe_s37_galata } oe_s37_gal_init = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cw_done NOT = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_cwseen } }
            set_variable = oe_s37_gal_cwseen
            set_variable = { name = oe_s37_gal_cwcd months = 6 }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_st NOT = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_done } } oe_s37_gal_step = yes }
    }
}
